items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The most musical period in the music was Bird and Bud and Dizzy Gillespie and Fats Navarro, you know they the masters.

ctx.x: You know. Dexter is a little slightly different than Bird. Well, see Bird was like the new era. I call him the, I was part of the renaissance, I call it the renaissance period. The most musical period in the music was Bird and Bud and Dizzy Gillespie and Fats Navarro, you know they the masters.
So Dexter was between now and sometime…
